Variants.Content: Wihtlaeg relies on kin chiefs and sailing partners. Crews, owners and cultivators bear different risks, requiring agreed numbers, shares and return dates.

Wihtlaeg relies on kin chiefs and sailing partners. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Crews, owners and cultivators bear different voyage costs.
